name: Checkbox
description: A labelled checkbox that fills with a press and draws its tick on, then undraws it and empties on the next click.

motion.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 120"><!-- {{label: text default='Remember me' label='Label'}} {{background: color default=#FFFFFF label='Background'}} {{border: color default=#9CA3AF label='Border'}} {{accent: color default=#6366F1 label='Checked'}} {{tick: color default=#FFFFFF label='Tick'}} {{ink: color default=#111827 label='Label colour'}} --><rect width="320" height="120" fill="{{background}}"/><g id="boxg" transform="translate(48 60) scale(1) translate(-48 -60)"><rect id="box" x="30" y="42" width="36" height="36" rx="9" fill="{{accent}}" fill-opacity="0" stroke="{{border}}" stroke-width="3"/><path id="tick" d="M39 60.5 L45.5 67 L58 53.5" fill="none" stroke="{{tick}}" stroke-width="4.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0"/></g><text x="84" y="{{base}}" textLength="{{length}}" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="{{size}}" font-weight="500" fill="{{ink}}">{{label}}</text></svg>
